# Human Rights Watch

> Human Rights Watch is a global human rights advocacy organization conducting investigations and campaigns across 100+ countries to expose abuses and drive policy change.

HRW combines investigative journalism, legal research, and advocacy to document human rights violations and hold governments accountable. The organization publishes reports, maintains multilingual content, and works on issues ranging from women's rights to government accountability across regions including the Middle East, Asia, Eastern Europe, and the Americas.

## Key Topics

- Human rights advocacy
- International investigations
- Government accountability
- Policy change
- Human rights violations
- International law
- Censorship and surveillance
- Women's rights
- Global coverage
- Press releases
- Activism
- Iran
- China
- Russia
- Palestine

## Global Advocacy & Impact

- [Human Rights Watch | Defending Human Rights Worldwide](https://www.hrw.org): HRW homepage: global human rights advocacy across 100 countries
- [Impact | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/impact): HRW impact stories: policy change, campaign victories, advocacy results
- [About Us | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/about/about-us): HRW organizational overview: mission, history, investigative methodology

## Research & Reports

- [Reports | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/publications): Searchable HRW reports database: World Report 2026, country investigations
- [Video & Photos | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/video-photos): HRW media gallery: documentaries, protest footage, investigative content

## Focus Areas

- [Women's Rights | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/topic/womens-rights): HRW women's rights advocacy: gender equality, intersectionality, justice

## Multilingual Content

- [Content in Other Languages | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/languages): HRW multilingual content hub with translations and global coverage
- [Human Rights Watch | الدفاع عن حقوق الناس في أنحاء العالم](https://www.hrw.org/ar): HRW Arabic language homepage for Middle East/North Africa region
- [人权观察 | 捍卫世界各地人权 | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/zh-hans): HRW Simplified Chinese homepage covering China, Tibet, Uyghur issues
- [人權觀察 | 捍衛世界各地人權 | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/zh-hant): HRW Traditional Chinese homepage: Hong Kong freedom, Tibet, Uyghur rights
- [Défendre les droits humains dans le monde | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/fr): HRW French language homepage: global human rights advocacy
- [Human Rights Watch | Verteidigung der Menschenrechte weltweit](https://www.hrw.org/de): HRW German language homepage: human rights defense worldwide
- [Human Rights Watch: 世界で人権を守る](https://www.hrw.org/ja): HRW Japanese homepage: global human rights advocacy and investigations
- [Human Rights Watch | Defendendo os direitos humanos em todo o mundo](https://www.hrw.org/pt): HRW Portuguese homepage: human rights advocacy in Brazil and globally
- [Human Rights Watch | На защите прав человека по всему миру](https://www.hrw.org/ru): HRW Russian homepage: Russia, Ukraine, Belarus human rights coverage
- [Human Rights Watch | En defensa de los derechos humanos en todo el mundo](https://www.hrw.org/es): HRW Spanish homepage: Latin America and global human rights advocacy
